parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.id)
  o.id AS opportunity_id, o.name AS deal_name,
  p.id AS proposal_id, p.public_token, p.email_subject, p.email_body,
  c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name,
  u.name AS owner_name, u.email AS owner_email, u.phone AS owner_phone
FROM deal_document_flows f
JOIN opportunities o ON o.stage_id = f.trigger_stage_id AND o.is_archived = false AND o.status = 'Open'
JOIN contacts c ON c.id = o.contact_id AND c.is_archived = false AND c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email <> ''
JOIN proposals p ON p.opportunity_id = o.id AND p.emailed_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.assigned_user
WHERE f.is_active = true
  AND o.stage_entered_at <= now() - (f.delay_hours || ' hours')::interval
ORDER BY o.id, p.created_at DESC;

nodes.name: Select Proposals Due To Send
nodes.notes: Only fires for deals that already have a draft proposal waiting (a rep must create one first) — if none exists yet, this simply returns 0 rows and nothing sends until one is created. DISTINCT ON picks the newest un-emailed proposal per deal, so re-creating a proposal supersedes an older unsent one.

parameters.query: UPDATE proposals SET status = 'emailed', emailed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1;

nodes.name: Mark Emailed
nodes.notes: Only runs after Gmail succeeds — a failed send leaves emailed_at null, so it's retried on the next 30-minute tick instead of being silently skipped.

parameters.query:
SELECT p.id AS proposal_id, p.public_token, f.proposal_reminder_email_subject, f.proposal_reminder_email_body,
  c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name, o.name AS deal_name
FROM deal_document_flows f
JOIN proposals p ON p.flow_id = f.id AND p.status = 'viewed'
JOIN opportunities o ON o.id = p.opportunity_id AND o.is_archived = false AND o.status = 'Open'
JOIN contacts c ON c.id = o.contact_id AND c.is_archived = false AND c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email <> ''
WHERE f.is_active = true
  AND f.proposal_reminder_delay_hours IS NOT NULL
  AND p.viewed_at IS NOT NULL
  AND p.viewed_at <= now() - (f.proposal_reminder_delay_hours || ' hours')::interval
  AND p.reminder_sent_at IS NULL;

nodes.name: Select Proposals Due For Reminder
nodes.notes: One-shot — reminder_sent_at gates it so a proposal only ever gets nudged once, regardless of how many more 30-minute ticks pass while it stays 'viewed'.

parameters.query: UPDATE proposals SET reminder_sent_at = now() WHERE id = $1;

nodes.name: Mark Reminder Sent
nodes.notes: Only runs after Gmail succeeds, same retry-on-failure pattern as Mark Emailed.
